nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the tool abstraction layer with ToolParameter, ToolSchema, ToolCapability dataclasses and the BaseTool abstract base class. All tools in the system inherit from BaseTool and implement get_name(), get_description(), get_schema(), and execute().
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3.12+, uses abc.ABC, dataclasses, type hints

nodes.name: ToolParameter
nodes.summary: Dataclass representing a single parameter of a tool's schema. Fields: name, type, description, required, enum.

nodes.name: ToolSchema
nodes.summary: Dataclass defining a tool's schema with name, description, and a list of ToolParameter objects.

nodes.name: ToolCapability
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing tool capabilities and risk profile: required_permissions, risk_level, cost_tier, confirmation_policy, readonly.

nodes.name: BaseTool
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for all tools. Defines the interface: get_name(), get_description(), get_schema(), get_capabilities(), execute(). Has a 'group' class attribute for categorization.

nodes.name: websearch.py
nodes.summary: Unified web search tool supporting multiple providers (Brave, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok). Implements web, news, image search, and scholar operations with in-process caching and provider auto-detection. Includes SSRF-safe redirect resolution.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses asyncio.to_thread for sync HTTP calls, in-process dict cache

nodes.name: WebOperationTool
nodes.summary: Unified web operations tool. Supports search, news, image_search, and scholar operations. Auto-detects provider from environment variables. Uses in-process cache with configurable TTL.

nodes.name: WebSearchTool
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible alias for WebOperationTool. Supports optional LLM model injection for Gemini-based search.

nodes.name: _search_brave
nodes.summary: Helper function that calls the Brave Search API for web, news, or image searches. Returns structured results list.

nodes.name: _search_perplexity
nodes.summary: Calls Perplexity/OpenRouter Sonar model for AI-synthesized search results with citations.

nodes.name: _search_gemini
nodes.summary: Uses Gemini with Google Search grounding. Resolves Google redirect URLs to direct URLs.

nodes.name: _search_grok
nodes.summary: Calls xAI Grok via OpenAI-compatible API for search queries.

nodes.name: _detect_provider
nodes.summary: Auto-detects search provider by checking env vars in order: Brave → Gemini → Perplexity → Grok.

nodes.name: webfetch.py
nodes.summary: Unified web fetch tool with SSRF-safe URL validation, BeautifulSoup HTML parsing, readability markdown extraction, Firecrawl fallback, and AI-powered summarization via Gemini. Supports fetch, summarize, extract_links, and metadata operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, optional dependencies: requests, bs4, google-genai/google-generativeai

nodes.name: WebFetchOperationTool
nodes.summary: Unified web fetch tool. Supports fetch, summarize, extract_links, metadata operations. Includes SSRF protection, Firecrawl fallback, and Gemini AI synthesis.

nodes.name: WebFetchTool
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible alias for WebFetchOperationTool. Adds prompt-to-URL extraction.

nodes.name: filetool.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive file operations tool with 35+ operations including basic I/O, content manipulation, searching, archiving (zip/tar), hashing, CSV operations, batch processing, symlinks, base64 encoding, and encoding detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses pathlib, shutil, zipfile, tarfile, csv, hashlib, base64

nodes.name: AdvancedFileOperationTool
nodes.summary: Advanced file operations tool with 35+ operations. Supports path validation against a base directory, automatic backup before mutation, human-readable file sizes, directory tree generation, and encoding detection.

nodes.name: writetool.py
nodes.summary: Todo list management tool. Allows the agent to write, update, and track todo lists with status management (pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled). Enforces single in_progress task rule.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, JSON parsing for input robustness

nodes.name: WriteTodosTool
nodes.summary: Todo list management tool. Overwrites the current todo list with a new list. Validates task structure, enforces single in_progress rule, and formats output for LLM consumption.

nodes.name: exectool.py
nodes.summary: Nuclear sandboxed shell executor using bubblewrap (bwrap). Provides filesystem isolation, network isolation, PID namespace isolation, and capability dropping. Integrates with security guard for command analysis.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, requires bubblewrap (bwrap) system package

nodes.name: ExecTool
nodes.summary: Nuclear sandboxed shell executor using bubblewrap. Read-only FS everywhere except workspace. Integrates with SecurityGuard for command analysis. Supports network toggle and extra env vars.

nodes.name: gittool.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Git operations tool covering status inspection, history, staging/committing, branching/merging, conflict resolution, remote syncing, cherry-picking, reverting, stashing, and tagging.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses asyncio.create_subprocess_exec for git CLI

nodes.name: GitOperationTool
nodes.summary: Full Git tool supporting 25+ operations: status, log, diff, blame, add, commit, branch, merge, fetch, pull, push, stash, tag, cherry-pick, revert, and more. Uses subprocess for git CLI execution.

nodes.name: memorytool.py
nodes.summary: Metacognitive memory tool that allows agents to permanently save facts, rules, and tool guides. Writes to ChromaDB vector store and maintains a human-readable flat-file audit log.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses ChromaDB for vector storage

nodes.name: MemoryTool
nodes.summary: Saves facts, rules, and tool guides to permanent memory (ChromaDB + flat file). Categories: FACT, RULE, TOOL_GUIDE. Injects _request for user context.

nodes.name: kgtool.py
nodes.summary: Knowledge graph tool with interchangeable Neo4j and HelixDB backends. Supports adding entity relationships, querying entity connections, and finding paths between entities. Includes dashboard helpers (list_entities, get_stats, search_entities).
nodes.languageNotes: Python, optional neo4j driver, HelixDB backend

nodes.name: KnowledgeGraphTool
nodes.summary: Knowledge graph with Neo4j/HelixDB backends. Operations: add_relationship, query_entity, find_path. Dashboard helpers: list_entities, get_stats, search_entities. Backend selected via KG_BACKEND env var.

nodes.name: browsertool.py
nodes.summary: Full browser automation tool using Playwright. Supports navigation, clicking, form filling, scrolling, screenshots, text extraction, JavaScript execution, tab management, and cookie handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, requires playwright + chromium

nodes.name: BrowserOperationTool
nodes.summary: Full Playwright browser automation. 20+ operations: navigate, click, fill, screenshot, extract_text, run_js, tab management, cookies. Uses asyncio.Lock for thread safety.

nodes.name: dockertool.py
nodes.summary: Docker management tool for monitoring containers, images, volumes, and networks. Supports listing, stats, inspection, start/stop/restart, pulling images, and system-wide pruning.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses docker SDK (optional)

nodes.name: DockerTool
nodes.summary: Docker management tool. Operations: list_containers, container_stats, inspect_container, start/stop/restart, list_images, pull_image, list_volumes, list_networks, system_info, prune.

nodes.name: financetools.py
nodes.summary: Collection of finance and security tools: StockQuoteTool (Yahoo Finance), CryptoAlertTool (CoinGecko), DNSLookupTool, HaveIBeenPwnedTool, URLVirusScanTool (VirusTotal), and CronManagerTool.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses requests, yfinance, dnspython

nodes.name: StockQuoteTool
nodes.summary: Real-time stock quotes and market data via Yahoo Finance. Operations: quote, history, search. Supports major exchanges.

nodes.name: CryptoAlertTool
nodes.summary: Cryptocurrency prices and alerts via CoinGecko (free, no key). Operations: price, alert, trending, history. Supports 1000+ coins.

nodes.name: DNSLookupTool
nodes.summary: DNS lookups for A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS, SOA, PTR records. Uses dnspython.

nodes.name: HaveIBeenPwnedTool
nodes.summary: Data breach checking for email addresses using Have I Been Pwned API. Returns breach details and statistics.

nodes.name: URLVirusScanTool
nodes.summary: URL malware/phishing scanning via VirusTotal API. Operations: scan, report. Returns threat classification and safety rating.

nodes.name: CronManagerTool
nodes.summary: Local crontab management. Operations: list, add, remove, execute. Uses subprocess to interact with crontab CLI.

nodes.name: weathertool.py
nodes.summary: Weather tool providing current conditions and 5-day forecasts via OpenWeatherMap API. Uses httpx for async HTTP.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses httpx for async HTTP

nodes.name: WeatherTool
nodes.summary: Current weather and 5-day forecast via OpenWeatherMap. Actions: current, forecast. Configurable default location.

nodes.name: remindertool.py
nodes.summary: Reminder management tool supporting one-time (ISO 8601) and recurring (cron) reminders. Integrates with the scheduler module for persistence and execution.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses app.core.scheduler

nodes.name: ReminderTool
nodes.summary: Set, list, and cancel reminders. Supports ISO 8601 one-shot and cron recurring reminders. Integrates with platform and chat_id for cross-platform delivery.

nodes.name: messagingtool.py
nodes.summary: Cross-platform messaging tool enabling the agent to act as a digital proxy. Sends messages to Telegram, Discord, or Slack via BotSignal.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses app.core.botsignal

nodes.name: PlatformMessagingTool
nodes.summary: Digital proxy for sending messages to Telegram, Discord, Slack. Uses BotSignal for platform dispatch. Validates numeric chat_ids for Discord/Telegram.

nodes.name: smarthometool.py
nodes.summary: Smart home control via Home Assistant REST API. Supports getting entity state, turning on/off, toggling, calling any HA service, and listing entities with domain filtering.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses httpx for async HTTP to Home Assistant

nodes.name: SmartHomeTool
nodes.summary: Home Assistant REST API integration. Operations: get_state, turn_on, turn_off, toggle, call_service, list_entities. Supports any HA domain.

nodes.name: imagegentool.py
nodes.summary: Image generation tool using xAI Aurora model via REST API. Returns URLs or base64-encoded images.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses httpx for async HTTP

nodes.name: ImageGenerationTool
nodes.summary: Generates images from text prompts using xAI Aurora model. Returns URL or base64 JSON. Supports 1-4 images per request.

nodes.name: resilience.py
nodes.summary: Tool resilience layer providing @with_retry (exponential backoff), @with_fallback, @with_timeout decorators, standardize_error for consistent error reporting, and ToolCircuitBreaker for preventing cascading failures.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses functools.wraps, asyncio

nodes.name: ToolCircuitBreaker
nodes.summary: Circuit breaker pattern for tools. States: CLOSED (normal), OPEN (blocked, cooldown), HALF_OPEN (test request). Tracks failure count and threshold.

nodes.name: standardize_error
nodes.summary: Creates a consistent error response dict with tool name, error type, context, recoverability flag, and user-friendly suggestion.

nodes.name: with_retry
nodes.summary: Decorator for automatic retry with exponential backoff. Configurable max_attempts, backoff_base, retry_on, skip_on.

nodes.name: with_timeout
nodes.summary: Decorator that aborts tool execution if it exceeds a configurable timeout.

nodes.name: with_fallback
nodes.summary: Decorator that tries the primary function, falling back to a secondary on failure.

nodes.name: sandbox.py
nodes.summary: Docker-based sandboxed shell execution. Runs commands in ephemeral Docker containers with workspace mount. Falls back to host execution if explicitly permitted.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses asyncio.create_subprocess_exec for Docker CLI

nodes.name: SandboxExecTool
nodes.summary: Docker-based sandboxed shell executor. Mounts workspace read-write, restricts network by default. Falls back to host if ALLOW_HOST_SHELL_EXECUTION is True.

nodes.name: rssreadertool.py
nodes.summary: RSS/Atom feed reader supporting fetch, headlines (multi-feed), list_feeds, and summarize operations. Uses feedparser library.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses feedparser, httpx

nodes.name: RSSReaderTool
nodes.summary: RSS/Atom feed reader. Operations: fetch (single feed), headlines (multi-feed), list_feeds (defaults), summarize. Parses with feedparser.

nodes.name: hackernews.py
nodes.summary: Advanced Hacker News tool for technology intelligence. Supports top/new/best stories, search, comments, user profiles, trending domains, keyword filtering, story summaries, and ranked stories.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses httpx, asyncio.gather for parallel fetches

nodes.name: HackerNewsTool
nodes.summary: Hacker News API tool. 12 operations: top, new, best, ask, jobs, search, get_story, get_comments, get_user, trending_domains, keyword_filter, story_summary, ranked_stories.

nodes.name: spotify.py
nodes.summary: Unified Spotify control tool preferring spogo CLI (with fallback to spotify_player). Supports playback control, search, device management, and like operations. Requires Spotify Premium.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, wraps spogo/spotify_player CLI via subprocess

nodes.name: SpotifyOperationTool
nodes.summary: Spotify control via spogo (preferred) or spotify_player CLI. Operations: status, play, pause, next, previous, search, device_list, device_set, like, play_uri.

nodes.name: gmailtool.py
nodes.summary: Full Gmail management tool using Google OAuth2. Supports send, read, list, search, delete, reply, mark read/unread, labels, drafts, and attachment download.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses google-api-python-client, google-auth, google-auth-oauthlib

nodes.name: GmailTool
nodes.summary: Gmail management via Google API. 14 operations: send_email, get_email, list_emails, get_unread, search_emails, delete_email, mark_read, mark_unread, reply_email, download_attachments, list_labels, create_label, create_draft, list_drafts.

nodes.name: googlecalender.py
nodes.summary: Google Calendar management tool using Google OAuth2. Supports listing calendars, event CRUD, search, recurring events, free/busy queries, quick-add, and moving events between calendars.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses google-api-python-client, google-auth, google-auth-oauthlib

nodes.name: GoogleCalendarTool
nodes.summary: Google Calendar management. 12 operations: list_calendars, list_events, get_event, search_events, create_event, update_event, delete_event, delete_events_bulk, move_event, quick_add, free_busy, get_recurring_instances.

nodes.name: workflowtool.py
nodes.summary: Durable multi-step workflow management tool. Exposes WorkflowEngine for creating, running, tracking, and advancing workflows with dependency chains.
nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses app.core.workflow_engine

nodes.name: WorkflowTool
nodes.summary: Workflow management via WorkflowEngine. Operations: list_workflows, get_workflow, create_workflow, run_workflow, list_runs, advance_step. Supports triggers: manual, schedule, event.
